title: Start the Day at Eight
parent_tip: Ask: is every reason backed up? Which claim is thinnest?

continued.text: On Thursday evening, the school board will hear comments from the public. Please come, bring your parents, and ask the board to let our school day begin when our minds actually do.

items.ask: What is the speaker's main purpose?
choices: to urge a later school start

items.ask: Which sentence uses parallel structure to sum up the speaker's point?
choices: We would arrive alert instead of exhausted, curious instead of cranky, and prepared instead of merely present.

items.ask: How does the speaker answer the worry about sports practices? Is her answer convincing?

answer_key: 1. C (to urge a later school start)
2. B (We would arrive alert instead of exhausted, curious instead of cranky, and prepared instead of merely present.)

3. Sample: The speaker admits the worry is real, saying "That concern is fair," which makes her sound reasonable. Then she answers it with a specific fact: practices would move back "a difference of only half an hour." Her answer is convincing because it shows the cost is small. Full answer: names the counterclaim, quotes her rebuttal, and judges whether the fact answers the worry
